title: Joel And Kerri — EN/ES/PT (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk mbira acoustic guitar Spanish Portuguese language learning warm baritone 104bpm brushed drums trilingual Zimbabwe-Australia family celebration
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Two worlds, one road.
Zimbabwe farm. Australia harbour.
Red dust and southern rain.
Joel and Kerri — two homelands, one name.

[Verse 2 - Spanish, with English translations]
Dos mundos, un camino. (Two worlds, one road.)
Granja de Zimbabue. Puerto de Australia. (Zimbabwe farm. Australia harbour.)
Polvo rojo y lluvia del sur. (Red dust and southern rain.)
Joel y Kerri — dos patrias, un nombre. (Joel and Kerri — two homelands, one name.)
Ella trajo el polvo rojo con ella (She brought the red dust with her)
En la forma en que saluda a los extraños. (In the way she says hello to strangers.)
Él ya estaba allí cuando ella llegó. (He was already there when she arrived.)
Construyeron un tercer país. (They built a third country.)

[Chorus - Portuguese, with English translations]
Joel e Kerri (Joel and Kerri)
Poeira vermelha e chuva do sul (Red dust and southern rain)
Joel e Kerri (Joel and Kerri)
Duas pátrias em um nome (Two homelands in one name)
O mbira toca e as árvores de goma respondem (The mbira plays and the gum trees answer)
De Harare até a luz do porto (From Harare to the harbour light)
Joel e Kerri (Joel and Kerri)
Acertando exatamente certo (Getting it exactly right)

[Bridge - all three]
English: They built a third country — the one not on any map.
Spanish: Construyeron un tercer país — el que no está en ningún mapa. (They built a third country — not on any map.)
Portuguese: Construíram um terceiro país — o que não está em nenhum mapa. (They built a third country — not on any map.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Joel and Kerri — yes
Spanish: Joel y Kerri — sí (Joel and Kerri — yes)
Portuguese: Joel e Kerri — sim (Joel and Kerri — yes)
